sample_unit: investigator analyses of one clinical trial dataset

links.outcome: Consistency of LLM clinical trial analyses across investigators and models
links.effect: Discrepancies across investigators' analyses in primary and secondary endpoints. One investigator found a significant PFS improvement contradicting the others. ORR and adverse event reporting varied between LLMs.
links.quote: While LLMs could process the trial data and generate relevant insights, discrepancies were observed across the investigators’ analyses, particularly in primary and secondary endpoints.

unlisted_practices: Chain-of-thought prompting framework to guide LLM statistical analysis of clinical trial data

screen.reason: Evaluates the feasibility, reliability, and consistency of LLMs (GPT-4 and Gemini) for statistical analysis and clinical trial data interpretation using de-identified clinical trial data, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard comparatively.
